heading: Termination of assistance

tree.text: shall be discontinued for any person whose conduct or progress is unsatisfactory under standards consistent with those established under section 3524 of title 38; and
may not be provided for any person for more than 45 months (or the equivalent in other than full-time education or training).

notes.text: Effective DateSection applicable with respect to persons whose captive status begins after Jan. 21, 1981, see section 806(d)(3) of Pub. L. 99–399, set out as a note under 2181 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 99–399, title VIII, § 806(d)(1), Aug. 27, 1986, 100 Stat. 888; amended Pub. L. 103–337, div. A, title X, § 1070(e)(7), Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 2859.)
